question: After SPPF failed under public-facade domain shift, can a broad-scene ADE20K semantic model directly produce door-component portal boxes with high positive retention and zero no-portal presence?

representation.name: Broad-Domain Door Component Field
representation.single_change: Replace the synthetic two-class SPPF model and the separate geometry proposer with raw connected components of ADE20K door and screen-door semantic pixels.
representation.why_this_source: ADE20K spans indoor and outdoor scene semantics and explicitly distinguishes door, screen door, glass, signboard, wall, road, and building. This directly targets the observed SPPF domain-shift failure instead of changing a matcher threshold.
representation.accuracy_choice: Freeze YOLO26x-sem rather than compare model sizes; the objective is first to prove the strongest visible effect.

model.training_role: Generic ADE20K scene parsing; no PB1-PB7 pixels, identities, or human truth used for training

runtime.backend: CUDA-only after the shared research-l10-r0 doctor verified real tensor execution; fail closed on unavailable CUDA or actual CPU fallback.

component_rule.ranking: Rank raw union-class components by semantic pixel area and retain Top-3.
component_rule.truth_membership: A component box is a portal-set member when its center lies inside the frozen region and at least half of its own area lies inside the region.
component_rule.forbidden_processing: No morphology, crop, TTA, class sweep, model-size comparison, geometry proposer, OCR input, target identity, or ensemble.

development_cohort.positives: The four consumed PB6 door-level positives.
development_cohort.negatives: The two consumed PB6 identity-bearing views with no entrance pixels.
development_cohort.ood_challenges: PMQ and AIRSIDE are recorded but excluded from threshold selection because both visibly contain a real open entrance or door leaves; their presence result is descriptive, not a false-positive label for this semantic source.

threshold_selection: Enumerate only observed Development component-area fractions from the four positives and two no-portal negatives, plus zero and the next value above the maximum. Among thresholds retaining a truth-member component in Top-3 on at least three of four positives and producing zero presence on both no-portal negatives, minimize negative false presence, maximize positive truth retention, then choose the largest threshold.
stop_rule: Run once. Do not change model size, semantic classes, bottom prior, connectivity, component ranking, threshold candidates, source roles, or gate after output. A pass freezes one new source-disjoint confirmation; a failure closes ADE20K door semantics without a class or model sweep.
next_step: If the Development gate passes, freeze the selected normalized area threshold and run one new entity-disjoint confirmation joined to unchanged SCIL. If it fails, change the information modality rather than tune this cohort.
claim_boundary: Development-only reuse of the consumed PB6 public-image cohort. A pass would show that broad-domain door semantics deserve fresh confirmation, not that a requested entity owns a portal or that the portal is public, open, traversable, actively observed, safe, or reached.
